not_served: category: lynch_category field NOT_SERVED; categories are my placement from growthRevenue, growthEPS, dividendYieldTTM, marketCap and industry
PEG, yield-adjusted PEG, effective P/E: NOT_COMPUTABLE (no forward or long-term growth served); PEG proxy in reads is trailing price-to-earnings over growthEPS or growthRevenue
cash and net cash per share: NOT_SERVED (debt_to_equity only)
bank vs funded debt and maturities (C15): NOT_SERVED
OCF and CapEx split (C16): NOT_SERVED (free_cash_flow_yield only)
fail gates (C24): NOT_TESTABLE; none reported as passed
two_minute_drill: NOT_POSSIBLE (no business description; stories are profile industry plus ratios)
currency: no profile currency field in the packet; ratios used are unitless
carried entries: ESTC, MA, V, MP from the 2026-10-21 pack, dated in their own profiles; multi-FY lists in reads are latest FY first
